description: Backtests a StockCharts.com scan on point-in-time US stocks since 2000, delisted names included: each rebalance (weekly by default) holds the stocks that pass the scan, equally weighted up to top_n, 10 bps costs. Optional symbols (e.g. a ChartList) restricts the universe. Returns the translation plus the same stats, benchmark and equity curve as run_backtest. Costs one backtest.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: backtest_stockcharts_scan
title: Backtest a StockCharts scan
